historic_survey.cr_status_note: Assigned on architectural criteria alone; the survey records it as provisional pending further research.
historic_survey.rating_note: The survey reports ratings from the 1976 citywide architectural survey on a 0-5 scale, 5 being individual significance of the highest degree. It gives no scale for the Carey & Company or UMB survey ratings, so those are recorded here but not shown on the page.
